li.label: tidy
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} can't abide a mess and cleans quickly and well. A filthy room puts {PAWN_objective} out of sorts.

li.label: green thumb
li.description: Seasons in the fields have taught {PAWN_nameDef} what every plant wants. {PAWN_pronoun} sows and harvests faster than most, and a little more comes of it.

li.label: born cook
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is at home at the stove. {PAWN_pronoun} cooks quickly, and keeps the kitchen clean enough that hardly anyone gets sick from {PAWN_possessive} food.

li.label: animal friend
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a name and a kind word for every animal, and they know it. Wild ones are tamed and tame ones trained more easily by {PAWN_objective}.

li.label: healer's hands
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has tended so many wounds that {PAWN_possessive} hands know the work by themselves. {PAWN_pronoun} tends faster and better than before.

li.label: trail-wise
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} knows the land around the colony like {PAWN_possessive} own room: where the game drinks, which way the wind carries. Animals rarely see {PAWN_objective} coming.
